As a Lead Data Scientist, you will own the path from revenue opportunity to production ML for Direct Revenue, the business unit responsible for growing active users, subscriptions, revenue-generating transactions, and in-app advertising across Life360's more than 100 million monthly active users. You will find the opportunities, size them, agree on priorities with business leads, and ship the models alongside the team's data scientists and engineers.

This role matters now because the team is expanding to cover consumer-facing ads, including recommendations and personalization, and needs a senior scientist who pairs a deep understanding of the problem with the ability to put models into production. In your first year, you will help the team scale the amount of production ML it delivers and help set the team's roadmap with the data science lead and the product manager.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $175,000 to $218,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $171,500 to $202,500 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

  • Conduct deep investigations into revenue-generating options and the data behind them, and use them to size, scope, and measure product changes in Databricks.
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate production ML systems, from batch inference to online services to online learning models, using the team's feature store and model registry, for personalization, experimentation, and automation use cases.
  • Partner with Product, Mobile Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, and MLOps to integrate these systems into user-facing features.
  • Set up monitoring for new ML-based features so their performance and business impact are measured.
  • Implement lineage tracking for data, code, and model artifacts to keep the ML lifecycle compliant, reproducible, and secure.
  • Improve the data ecosystem with Data Engineering, including the pipelines that feed experimentation and ML.
  • Mentor other data scientists and define best practices for advanced analytics and ML system development.
  • Use Claude Code and other AI tools across data discovery, modeling, and experiment evaluation.

  • Education: advanced degree in a field that relies on sophisticated statistical analysis or equivalent industry experience.
  • Professional Experience: 6+ years of experience scoping, building, and analyzing ML-powered systems, including models you have shipped to production.
  • Programming Proficiency: Significant experience with Python and scikit-learn, PySpark, and causal inference programming languages, including familiarity with software engineering best practices (testing, modularization, version control, etc.).
  • Causal Inference: Technical training and professional experience applying modern causal inference and causal analysis techniques.
  • Instrumentation and Measurement: Significant experience working with found data, guiding instrumentation to generate new data, and implementing data transformations to support complex analyses and ML system development.
  • Experimentation: Hands-on experience setting up experiments in the consumer technology space, including experiment design, monitoring, and analysis of results.
  • Consumer Product Experience: Experience building ML or running experiments at a consumer (B2C) technology company, ideally on revenue work such as subscriptions, transactions, or ads.
  • Communication and Leadership: Strong communication and project leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Problem Solving: Strong capability to solve ambiguous problems in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way.
  • Generative AI & LLMs: Prior experience leveraging LLMs in advanced data processing and analysis workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Digital Advertising: Experience with modern digital advertising, including ad tech infrastructure.
  • Feeds and Ranking: Experience with ranking and grouping algorithms for content feeds.
  • Advanced Tooling: Experience contributing to and managing production feature stores and ML model registries.
  • Revenue Partnership: Experience working with product line GMs, including familiarity with revenue reporting and forecasting analyses.
  • Subscription Products: Experience in subscription-based products, lifecycle marketing, or user acquisition.
  • Geospatial: Experience with geospatial data and mobile location-based services.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: Running parallel workstreams instead of hand-holding one agent at a time.
  • Judgment and ownership: Review AI-generated code, analyses, and models as critically as a colleague's pull request. You are accountable for everything you ship, whoever or whatever wrote it.

  • Continuous learning: Keep up with new AI tools and techniques, test them on real team problems, and bring recommendations to the team.

Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Growth to join our AI Growth team and help build the systems that enable customers to understand, adopt, and realize value from AI across our platform. You’ll build and maintain backend services and data pipelines that power AI usage metering, reporting, billing integrations, and model availability. As part of a newly formed team, you’ll work closely with Product, AI, Business Intelligence, Finance, and Platform Engineering to solve complex technical and data challenges while helping establish the architecture and engineering practices that will support the team as it grows.

You will:

Design & Build

  • Build and maintain production-grade backend services that support AI usage metering, reporting, billing integrations, and model availability.
  • Design and develop data pipelines and event-driven systems that reliably process usage and product data at scale.
  • Build cloud-native services using C#, AWS, and modern backend architecture patterns.
  • Develop integrations across AI, product, data, billing, and platform systems.
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and actively participate in code reviews to improve engineering quality across the team.

  • Contribute to system design and architecture decisions across backend services, data pipelines, and integrations.
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs and help establish scalable patterns as the AI Growth platform evolves.
  • Design distributed systems using AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, and S3.
  • Contribute to event-driven architectures and data infrastructure supporting AI usage and product analytics.
  • Help translate evolving product and business requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions.

Reliability & Operational Excellence

De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden:

  • Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren

  • Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen

  • Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten

  • Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes

Professionele vaardigheden:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol

  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines

Pré:

  • Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen

  • Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools

  • Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure

  • Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering


Waarom werken bij PuurData?
